parameters.name: request.user
parameters.rationale: Django request.user object central to all authentication and role checks in the LMS app.

parameters.name: request.user.is_superuser
parameters.rationale: Flag checked in admin_required and lecturer_required/student_required decorators as override for full access.

parameters.name: request.user.is_lecturer
parameters.rationale: Custom flag checked in lecturer_required decorator to verify user has lecturer role.

parameters.name: request.user.is_student
parameters.rationale: Custom flag checked in student_required decorator to verify user has student role.

parameters.name: request.user.is_active
parameters.rationale: Active-user flag checked inside student_required, lecturer_required, and admin_required decorators before granting role-based access.

parameters.name: request.user.has_perm
parameters.rationale: Django permission-check method used in a terminating authorization condition.
